extracted.intended_audience: parents and filmmakers (those submitting films for rating)
extracted.subtask_description: Official Motion Picture Association guidance describing the purpose, decision process, and category definitions used by the Classification and Ratings Administration (CARA) to rate films for parental guidance. Useful for parents deciding appropriateness and filmmakers submitting films for rating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: Informing Parents
rubrics_metrics.description: Established in 1968, the film rating system provides parents with the information needed to determine if a film is appropriate for their children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ratings exist to help parents make informed viewing choices for their children; historical context and additional resources are available at FilmRatings.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ratings determination process (CARA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratings are determined by the Classification and Ratings Administration (CARA), via a board comprised of an independent group of parents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions are made by an independent parent board to reflect parental perspectives; filmmakers may start a submission process with CARA to have a film rated.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Audiences (G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nothing that would offend parents for viewing by children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to indicate content appropriate for all ages; parents should expect no material likely to upset children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parental Guidance Suggested (PG)
rubrics_metrics.description: Parents urged to give “parental guidance.” May contain some material parents might not like for their young children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggests some content could be unsuitable for very young children and that parents should consider guidance before viewing with young kids.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parents Strongly Cautioned (PG-13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Parents are urged to be cautious. Some material may be inappropriate for pre-teenagers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals stronger caution than PG; parents of pre-teens should be particularly attentive to content that may not be suitable for that age group.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restricted (R)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains some adult material. Parents are urged to learn more about the film before taking their young children with them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates presence of adult themes or content; parents should seek more information about the specific material before allowing children to view.

rubrics_metrics.name: No one 17 and Under Admitted (NC-17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearly adult. Children are not admitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denotes films intended solely for adults; admission is restricted to persons older than 17.
